### ⚠️ Requires [Provi's Origins](https://github.com/Provismet/Provi-Origins/wiki) to be installed! ⚠️

## Double Jump

---

[Entity Action Type](https://github.com/Provismet/Provi-Origins/wiki/Double-Jump)

Adds velocity to the y-axis. This action is *almost* equivalent to using the [Add Velocity](https://github.com/Provismet/Provi-Origins/wiki/Double-Jump) action. However, it only *sets* the y-axis velocity and does not change velocity on the x-axis or z-axis; this action is ideal for double jumps that don't break your momentum (the standard kind found in other games).

Type ID: `proviorigins:double_jump`

## Fields

---

## Examples
```json
"entity_action": {
    "type": "proviorigins:double_jump",
    "velocity": 0.42,
}
```
This example will send the player upwards with the same velocity as a standard jump.

x-intellij-html-description:
Entity Action Type

Adds velocity to the y-axis. This action is almost equivalent to using the Add Velocity action. However, it only sets the y-axis velocity and does not change velocity on the x-axis or z-axis; this action is ideal for double jumps that don't break your momentum (the standard kind found in other games).

Type ID: proviorigins:double_jump

Fields

Field Type Default Description
velocity Float How much velocity to set the y-axis to.
client Boolean true Should the action execute on the server.
server Boolean true Should the action execute on the client.
reset_fall_height Boolean true Determines whether the action will reset the fall height of the entity.

Examples

"entity_action": {
    "type": "proviorigins:double_jump",
    "velocity": 0.42,
}

This example will send the player upwards with the same velocity as a standard jump.
